digest.component_or_area: workflow gate (plan review and completion verification)
propositions: Description length must be enforced as a blocking gate at both plan review (before LLM calls) and completion verification (before runner calls), with a configurable default maximum of 8,000 characters.
Exactly 8,000 characters is permitted; 8,001 characters triggers a deterministic BLOCK or FAIL with zero LLM/runner execution and no content truncation.
In light bug review, the P4 description finding must be retained as blocking while other DET blocks are downgraded to advisory to maintain the shared deterministic short circuit.
Completion verification must check the authoritative ticket description immediately after loading the verify configuration and before child checks or context assembly.

Historical calibration across 2,202 tickets showed that 8,000 characters affects only 0.82% of work tickets while materially reducing plan-review latency and improving completion-verification PASS rates.
Configuration must be typed and require positive integers, with ConfigError fail-fast semantics preserved for invalid settings rather than silent defaults.
